my watch says my resting hr dropped from 64 to 58 over two months. what does that mean

A falling resting heart rate usually means improving cardiovascular fitness — your heart moves the same blood with fewer beats. A 6 bpm drop over two months of regular exercise is a textbook good sign. (If it came with dizziness or unusual fatigue instead, that'd be a doctor question.)
